Variants.Content: Lemon Grove is located in eastern Dorne, near the Greenblood River and the hinterland of Sunspear. It is the territory of House Dart. It belongs to the dominion of the Prince of Dorne, and its name comes from the orchards in the warm irrigated area of ​​​​the area; the water source, citrus and the road to Sunspear explain its value better than the grand city defense.

Entry Lemonwood Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.

Entry Lemonwood They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Lemonwood If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

From workshops to sanctuaries, Lemon Grove juxtaposes stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and the seams left by generations of repairs with the shared memory of the Seven, the Rhoynar legacy, and the different bloodlines under the Prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Lemonwood They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
